classified_object.notes: FAI F9U-class racing; craft and FPV stack are products within the athletic system.

performance_agency.summary: Pilot skill during the race is decisive under remote control.

performance_interface.summary: Radio control and FPV; human body not co-located with craft.

embodied_performance.summary: Radio control and FPV; human body not co-located with craft. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Physical course gates/obstacles; FPV provides mediated sensing of that arena.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Radio command, FPV video, timing, and course state connect pilot and aircraft.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Equipment classes, frequencies, timing, and course configuration bound comparison.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Officials observe the physical course and results systems.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Pilot zones, spectator separation, frequency control, and flyaway procedures govern risk.

sensing_tracking.summary: FPV video, timing, and fail-safe systems.

measurement.summary: Lap/race timing and World Cup points.

comparability.summary: Depends on class limits and course setup across events.

officiation.summary: Event officiation under FAI sporting structures.

outcome_openness.summary: Race outcomes depend on pilot performance and reliability.

consequence_structure.summary: Ranking, elimination, crash risk to equipment, safety zones.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Remote control coupled to physical course via computational sensing/display; not automatically a computationally constituted arena.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Remote performance agency over physical course; spatial membership unresolved pending sharper operational-space criteria.

content: Clearer Altis criteria distinguishing remote physical-craft control from computationally constituted arenas.
Events where digital overlays become rule-bearing in the same contest state.
